cues.text: Once, I was seven years old, my mama told me
cues.translation: 그때 난 일곱 살이었고 엄마는 말했지

cues.text: "Go make yourself some friends, or you'll be lonely"
cues.translation: 친구를 좀 사귀렴 안 그러면 외로울 거야

cues.text: Once, I was seven years old
It was a big-big world, but we thought we were bigger
cues.translation: 세상은 아주 컸지만 우린 우리가 더 큰 줄 알았어

cues.text: Pushing each other to the limits,
we were learning quicker
By 11, smoking herb and drinking burning liquor
cues.translation: 열한 살엔 대마초를 피우고 독한 술을 마셨어

cues.text: Never rich, so we were out to make that steady figure
cues.translation: 부자가 아니었기에 꾸준히 돈 벌 길을 찾았지

cues.text: Once, I was 11 years old, my daddy told me
cues.translation: 그때 난 열한 살이었고 아빠는 말했지

cues.text: "Go get yourself a wife, or you'll be lonely"
cues.translation: 아내를 맞이하렴 안 그러면 외로울 거야

cues.text: Once, I was 11 years old
I always had that dream like my daddy before me
cues.translation: 늘 아빠가 그랬듯 나도 그런 꿈을 꿨어

cues.text: So I started writing songs, I started writing stories
cues.translation: 그래서 노래를 쓰고 이야기를 쓰기 시작했지

cues.text: Something about the glory
just always seemed to bore me
'Cause only those I really love
will ever really know me
Once, I was 20 years old, my story got told
cues.translation: 스무 살이던 때 내 이야기가 세상에 알려졌어

cues.text: Before the morning sun, when life was lonely
Once, I was 20 years old
(Lukas Graham!)
I only see my goals, I don't believe in failure
'Cause I know the smallest voices,
they can make it major
cues.translation: 크게 울릴 수 있다는 걸 아니까

cues.text: I got my boys with me, at least those in favor
And if we don't meet before I leave,
I hope I'll see you later
Once, I was 20 years old, my story got told
cues.translation: 스무 살이던 때 내 이야기가 세상에 알려졌어

cues.text: I was writing 'bout everything, I saw before me
cues.translation: 눈앞에서 본 모든 걸 글로 쓰고 있었어

cues.text: Once, I was 20 years old
Soon, we'll be 30 years old, our songs have been sold
cues.translation: 머잖아 우린 서른 살이 되고 우리 노래는 팔리겠지

cues.text: We've traveled around the world,
and we're still roaming
Soon, we'll be 30 years old
cues.translation: 머잖아 우린 서른 살이 될 거야

cues.text: I'm still learning about life,
my woman brought children for me
cues.translation: 내 여자는 내게 아이들을 안겨 줬어

cues.text: So I can sing them all my songs,
and I can tell them stories
Most of my boys are with me,
some are still out seeking glory
And some I had to leave behind,
my brother, I'm still sorry
Soon, I'll be 60 years old, my daddy got 61
cues.translation: 머잖아 난 예순이 되고 아빠는 예순한 살이 됐지

cues.text: Remember life and then your life becomes a better one
cues.translation: 삶을 기억해 그러면 네 삶은 더 나은 것이 돼

cues.text: I made the man so happy
cues.translation: 한 번 편지를 썼을 때 아버지를

cues.text: when I wrote a letter once
I hope my children come and visit,
once or twice a month
Soon, I'll be 60 years old,
will I think the world is cold?
Or will I have a lot of children who can warm me?
cues.translation: 아니면 나를 따뜻하게 해 줄 아이들이 많을까

cues.text: Soon, I'll be 60 years old
Soon, I'll be 60 years old,
will I think the world is cold?
Or will I have a lot of children who can hold me?
cues.translation: 아니면 나를 안아 줄 아이들이 많을까
